title: Chapter 13 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of animation clips, Animator Controller, transitions, parameters, and blend trees!

questions.question: What is the modern animation system in Unity called?
questions.explanation: Mecanim is the state‑machine‑based animation system.

questions.question: Which component is required to play animations using an Animator Controller?
questions.explanation: The Animator component runs the controller.

questions.question: How do you create a new animation clip?
options: In the Project window, right‑click → Create → Animation Clip
In the Animation window, select a GameObject and click Create
Animation clips can only be imported
questions.explanation: The Animation window's Create button records a new clip on the selected object.

questions.question: What does a keyframe represent?
options: The final frame of the animation
A snapshot of a property's value at a specific time
The frame rate of the animation
The name of the animation clip
questions.explanation: Keyframes store property values at given times.

questions.question: You can animate a material's color with an animation clip.
questions.explanation: Almost any public property can be animated, including material colors.

questions.question: Where do you assign an Animator Controller to a GameObject?
options: In the Animator component's Controller field
questions.explanation: Drag the controller asset into the Animator component's Controller slot.

questions.question: What does the 'Any State' node do in an Animator Controller?
options: It can transition to any other state at any time
questions.explanation: Any State allows transitions from any state without needing explicit connections.

questions.question: What is a transition condition based on?
questions.explanation: Conditions compare parameters to values.

questions.question: Which parameter type is ideal for a one‑shot action like 'Fire'?
questions.explanation: Triggers are set and then automatically consumed by a transition.

questions.question: How do you set a float parameter named 'Speed' from script?
questions.explanation: Use SetFloat on the Animator component.

questions.question: What does disabling 'Has Exit Time' on a transition do?
options: Allows the transition to happen immediately when conditions are met
questions.explanation: Without exit time, the condition check triggers the transition instantly.

questions.question: What is a Blend Tree?
options: A state that blends multiple animations based on parameters
questions.explanation: Blend Trees smoothly interpolate between motion clips.

questions.question: In a 1D Blend Tree, what determines the blend weight?
options: A single float parameter and threshold values
questions.explanation: 1D blends along one float axis with thresholds.

questions.question: How do you add a motion to a Blend Tree?
options: Drag a clip into the Blend Tree inspector's motion list
Use the Animator window's Add Motion button
questions.explanation: In the Inspector for the Blend Tree, you can add motion fields and assign clips.

questions.question: What is an Animation Event?
options: A way to call a function at a specific time in an animation clip
questions.explanation: Animation Events trigger script methods during playback.

questions.question: Root Motion moves a character based on the animation's movement data.
questions.explanation: When Apply Root Motion is on, animation movement drives the GameObject's transform.

questions.question: How do you create a transition between two states?
options: Right‑click a state → Make Transition, then click the target state
Drag a line from one state to another
questions.explanation: Right‑click → Make Transition is the way to connect states.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'Entry' node?
options: To mark the end of the animation
To define the default state that starts playing
questions.explanation: The Entry node points to the initial state.

questions.question: Which update mode on the Animator is best for physics‑driven animations?
questions.explanation: Animate Physics synchronizes the Animator update with FixedUpdate.

questions.question: How can you prevent a transition from occurring instantly when conditions are met?
options: Use a trigger instead of bool
Enable 'Has Exit Time' and set an exit time
questions.explanation: Has Exit Time forces the current clip to play for a minimum duration before transitioning.

questions.question: If you want a character to walk when speed is between 0.1 and 2, and run above 2, what would you set in a 1D Blend Tree?
questions.explanation: Thresholds define the parameter values at which each animation plays fully.

questions.question: In script, how do you get a reference to the Animator on the same GameObject?
questions.explanation: Standard GetComponent call.

questions.question: You can use a bool parameter to instantly switch animations without a transition duration.
questions.explanation: If Has Exit Time is off and transition duration is 0, it's instant.

questions.question: What does the 'Culling Mode' on Animator do?
options: It determines how animations are blended
It optimizes performance when the character is off‑screen
questions.explanation: Culling Mode can stop animation updates when not visible to save CPU.
